name_note: A small number of genomes that NCBI names Haemophilus aegyptius fall inside this GTDB species, so it is slightly broader than Haemophilus influenzae in papers.

sentences.text: Haemophilus influenzae is a colonizer of the nasopharynx whose strains commonly reside as commensals within the human pharynx and can remain as an asymptomatic carrier.
Among 404 healthy children less than 5 years of age in Murcia, Spain, 27.7% had colonization, and younger age and the winter period were reported as facilitating factors.
A cross-sectional study of 902 children in Tehran reported a carriage rate of 29%, with a nasopharyngeal type b carrier rate of 2.6%.
